title: Mara and the Winter
author: Coral Thornbury
blurb: Jonah Iversen, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
